source: Starting point, not official. Mesa Mark IIC+ lead, scooped mids (tonemirror: gain 8, bass 6, mid 4, treble 6, presence 7; Guitar Chalk Mark IV guide: gain 7, treble 7, presence 6, light delay on solos). BG MARK3 is the pedal's closest Mesa. A low-gain Tube Screamer tightens the palm mutes. Solo delay syncs to the pedal tempo (tap tempo).
